description: Fetch an https URL through an SSRF-guarded proxy and return a JSON envelope with the scanned body (HTTP 200 envelope, upstream status inside) (0.025 USDC per call). Heuristic screening — will miss attacks.

allow.description: Comma-separated hostnames or *.suffix patterns; when set the target must match

include_blocked.description: Return the body even when the content scan verdict is block (default false)

name: shield_proxy_fetch
